_meta.note: Hand-mapped from standard K-IFRS statement line-item names (계정명, DART fnlttSinglAcntAll account_nm) to standard IFRS English terms. Not machine translation.
_meta.coverage: Core line items shared across most listed companies, built 2026-09-10 from a 9-company sample (Samsung Electronics, KB Financial Group, POSCO Holdings, Lotte Shopping, Hyundai Motor Securities, Shinhan Financial Group, Korean Air) across five statements. Sample of 677 distinct account names found across those 9 filings; this file covers the recurring core, not the long tail of company-specific one-off lines.
_meta.unmeasured: Real coverage (붙은 수/전체 수) cannot be measured until 6번's F1 collector (fnlttSinglAcntAll sweep, target 2026-09-13) runs across all 2,765 listed companies. Expand this file by frequency once that data exists — do not guess ahead of it.
_meta.fallback: Any account_nm not in this file returns "unmapped:<원문>" — never a guessed translation.
